text: dsh-openai-siwc 是一个 DSH 模型提供方插件：通过 ChatGPT 账号接入 OpenAI 的模型服务。它向 DSH 注册模型适配器和 ChatGPT 授权流程，并提供 /siwc 命令管理登录状态。主要功能包括读取账号可用模型目录、流式生成文本、进行多轮对话与工具调用，以及按模型能力处理图像输入和推理等级。适合希望在本机 DSH 中使用 ChatGPT plan 的用户。使用前需要符合条件且授权 plan usage 的 ChatGPT Plus 或 Pro 账号；登录时使用系统浏览器，模型请求发送到 OpenAI 服务。

dsh-openai-siwc connects DSH to OpenAI models through ChatGPT sign-in. It lists available models and supports streaming, tool calls, image input, and reasoning controls. Use /siwc to sign in, check status, list models, or log out. A qualifying ChatGPT Plus or Pro account is required.

dsh-openai-siwc 的功能「ChatGPT 授权」：通过 /siwc login 在系统浏览器完成账号授权，再将授权结果保存到 DSH 凭据服务。用户可添加其他账号并选择已保存账号。
dsh-openai-siwc 的功能「模型目录」：适配器读取当前账号可见的模型列表并向 DSH 模型选择器提供模型名称、输入模态和推理等级信息。
dsh-openai-siwc 的功能「对话生成」：将 DSH 请求转换为 Responses API 输入并返回流式结果，支持多轮文本对话和工具调用。
dsh-openai-siwc 的功能「图像输入」：对支持图像的模型，将附件转换为内联图像数据；当请求图片超出配置预算时，可卸载较早图片。
dsh-openai-siwc 使用前须知：需在 ChatGPT 授权时允许 plan usage；模型请求会发送到 OpenAI 的认证与 API 服务，并通过本机回环地址接收 OAuth 回调。

@hackforjoy/dsh-openai-siwc README · dsh-openai-siwc：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

An LLM provider plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH). It uses OpenAI's official **Sign in with ChatGPT — ChatGPT plan usage for open-source clients** (SIWC) so DSH can call models with your ChatGPT account and plan.

@hackforjoy/dsh-openai-siwc README · dsh-openai-siwc：- traditional Codex OAuth (what DSH's built-in `openai-codex` provider uses);
- an OpenAI API key provider. It never treats a SIWC token as an API key and never falls back to another billing path when a request fails.

@hackforjoy/dsh-openai-siwc README · Install：Install into a profile with the DSH CLI (it records the plugin in the profile's `dependencies` and `dsh.profile.bundles`):

```sh
DSH="/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh"   # macOS
"$DSH" plugin --profile <profile> add @hackforjoy/dsh-openai-siwc
```

Then start the profile (for example `"$DSH" <profile>`). The bundled `cordis.patch.yml` mounts the plugin under the id `openai-siwc`.
@hackforjoy/dsh-openai-siwc README · Install：To install from source, see [Development](#development).

@hackforjoy/dsh-openai-siwc README · Configuration (optional)：Override by id in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: openai-siwc
  name: '@hackforjoy/dsh-openai-siwc'
  config:
    defaultContextWindow: 128000     # only for models whose catalog entry has no context_window

The OpenAI endpoints are **not configurable**, so a tampered configuration cannot send tokens elsewhere.
@hackforjoy/dsh-openai-siwc README · Sign in：DSH 0.2.1's settings UI has no entry point for third-party authorization flows yet, so sign-in uses a slash command:

@hackforjoy/dsh-openai-siwc README · Sign in：The authorization URL goes only to the browser; it never appears in command output or session logs. If plan usage is not granted, the plugin keeps the sign-in but requests fail with `SIWC_PLAN_USAGE_DISABLED` — sign in again and allow it.

@hackforjoy/dsh-openai-siwc README · Differences from other providers：| DSH parameter | Behavior | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `temperature` | **Error** `UNSUPPORTED_PARAMETER` | Forbidden by the docs; silently dropping it would change the output |
| `stop` | **Error** `UNSUPPORTED_PARAMETER` | The Responses API has no stop sequences |
| `reasoningEffort` | Sent as `reasoning.effort` | Levels come from the account catalog, intersected with the values the API accepts (the catalog's `ultra` is rejected by the API and therefore dropped). "Default" leaves the server's own default |
| `maxTokens` | **Not sent**, logged once | The docs forbid `max_output_tokens`. DSH's compaction and session titles always pass it; it is only a cap, so omitting it does not affect correctness |
| Image input | Image-capable models (per catalog): inline data URLs, including images in tool results. Text-only models: text placeholders | At most 20 MiB of base64 images per request by default (`maxRequestImageBytes`); beyond that DSH offloads the oldest images |
| Reasoning replay | Not replayed | `store: false`, and no encrypted reasoning content is available |

@hackforjoy/dsh-openai-siwc README · Sign out：```
/siwc logout
```

Stops using the tokens, revokes the refresh token with OpenAI (retrying on failure), then deletes the local tokens. The issued client id and this host's id are kept for the next sign-in. If revocation cannot be confirmed, the plugin says so; you can then disconnect the app in ChatGPT settings.

> Deleting the `openai-siwc/session` record in DSH settings is **local only** and does not revoke the session remotely.

@hackforjoy/dsh-openai-siwc README · Credential storage：Refresh runs inside DSH's cross-process exclusive write, so several DSH processes never race a rotating refresh token. See [`docs/security/threat-model.md`](docs/security/threat-model.md) for the security design and [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for reporting vulnerabilities.

@hackforjoy/dsh-openai-siwc README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom / code | Cause and fix |
|---|---|
| `MISSING_CREDENTIAL` | Not signed in. Run `/siwc login` |
| `SIWC_PLAN_USAGE_DISABLED` | Plan usage was not granted at sign-in. Run `/siwc login` and allow it |
| Sign-in fails with `invalid_grant` | Most often the account is not Plus/Pro (Free accounts are refused at the code exchange). After upgrading, run `/siwc login` again; the plugin reuses the client id it kept |
| "Could not open the system browser" | No system browser could be launched (e.g. a headless machine); the plugin only supports running locally |
| Sign-in reports "declined in the browser" | Authorization was declined. Sign in again and allow it, or use another provider (such as your own API key) |
| Sign-in reports "Registration incomplete" | The callback carried no issued client_id. Sign in again |
| Sign-in reports "ID token failed validation" | The ID token failed signature or claim checks and was not stored. Check the system clock and retry |
| `QUOTA` (`subscription_sharing_usage_limit_exceeded`) | ChatGPT plan usage limit reached (possibly a per-app limit). See <https://chatgpt.com/settings/usage>. Not retried
@hackforjoy/dsh-openai-siwc README · Troubleshooting：Every error message includes the HTTP status and OpenAI's request id when available, and never a token.

@hackforjoy/dsh-openai-siwc README · Development：```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
pnpm typecheck   # tsc --noEmit (including tests)
pnpm test        # vitest: unit + integration tests (real DSH services + local mock OpenAI)
pnpm build       # output to lib/

Install a local build into DSH: `"$DSH" plugin --profile <profile> add "file:/absolute/path/hackforjoy-dsh-openai-siwc-<version>.tgz"`. Re-installing the same version requires `remove` then `add`.

@hackforjoy/dsh-openai-siwc README · Development：The integration tests mount the real `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`, `dsh-authorization`, `dsh-credentials-local`, and `dsh-attachment-local` (all on temp directories) against `tests/helpers/mock-openai.ts`. The mock implements the official protocol strictly — PKCE is verified, `redirect_uri`/`resource`/`client_id` must match, refresh tokens rotate and reuse is rejected, forbidden fields are refused — and reproduces live behavior observed on the real endpoint (SSE without `Content-Type`, `x-oai-request-id`). `DSH_HOME` points at a temp directory, so tests never touch a real `~/.dsh`.

@hackforjoy/dsh-openai-siwc README · Development：Each [GitHub Release](https://github.com/HackForJoy/dsh-openai-siwc/releases) attaches the exact npm tarball and its `SHA256SUMS` (`sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`). From 0.1.1 on, npm versions are published by GitHub Actions through npm Trusted Publishing with provenance, linking each version to the commit and workflow run that built it; 0.1.0 was published manually and has no provenance.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) to contribute and [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) for release notes.

@hackforjoy/dsh-openai-siwc README · Verification status and limitations：- **Verified against the real service (DSH 0.2.1-rc.3, an eligible ChatGPT account)**: sign-in, sign-in again after logout, model list, streaming text, multi-turn, tool-call round trips, token refresh and rotation, reasoning effort, image input, logout with remote revocation; no tokens in logs or session files.
- Not yet verified against the real service: adding a second account with `/siwc login new`; a real `IMAGE_OFFLOAD_REQUIRED` (the server's image limit is unpublished).
- Behavior the official docs leave open, as observed on the real service: [`docs/research/openai-siwc-protocol.md` §16](docs/research/openai-siwc-protocol.md).
- One active account at a time (several can be saved and chosen at sign-in).
- Architecture decisions: [`docs/adr/ADR-001-siwc-provider-plugin.md`](docs/adr/ADR-001-siwc-provider-plugin.md).
